paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the negative log probabilities of clinically relevant tokens across different clinical specialties, representing data from a baseline model and several fine-tuned models. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and displays six categories ordered alphabetically: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The data is visualized using downward-pointing grouped bars that originate from the top axis line at -22. Each horizontal category contains a group of seven adjacent bars. As indicated by the legends at the top of the chart, the first bar in each group is colored light blue, representing "Mistralv0.2-Base." The remaining six bars in each group correspond to models "Fine-tuned on:" specific specialties, identified by color: light beige (Cardio), peach (Gastro), light orange (Infect), orange (Neuro), brown (Obstetrics), and dark brown (Pediatrics). Across all groups, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bars exhibit the longest downward extensions, reaching lowest values between approximately -23.8 in the Infect category and -26.8 in the Cardio category. The six fine-tuned model bars show consistently shorter downward extensions across all groups, with values ranging from roughly -22.9, seen in several bars within the Infect category, down to approximately -26.1, seen in the dark brown Pediatrics bar within the Cardio category. Both the categories on the horizontal axis and the fine-tuned model legend entries are sorted alphabetically, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
